content.title: Where to stream Sporting CP vs. Bodø/Glimt Champions League today: Tuesday, March 17
content.text: Updated: Mar. 17, 2026, 12:22 p.m.Published: Mar. 17, 2026, 12:21 p.m.Watch Sporting's Morten Hjulmand, front, and Bodø/Glimt's Sondre Auklend fight for the ball on Tuesday, March 17 in the 2nd Leg of their UEFA Champions League Round of 16 matchup. (Fredrik Varfjell/NTB Scanpix via AP)APIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Khadrice Rollins | KRollins@masslive.comThe first ticket to get punched for the UEFA Champions League Quarterfinals will happen on Tuesday, March 17 at Estádio José Alvalade in Lisbon, Portugal where Sporting CP is looking to come back against Bodø/Glimt.This soccer match is scheduled to start at 1:45 p.m. EDT and will be broadcast on Paramount+ and CBSSN. Fans looking to watch this match can do so for free by using DIRECTV, which offers a free trial, or FuboTV, which also offers a free trial as well as up to $30 off your first month.
